title: Analysis plan frozen
site_change: Every page states this date: the tests were fixed before any fire data was opened.

title: Registered tests run once and committed
site_change: The results and the methods pages read run1.

title: October's ERA5-Land monthly data
site_change: The tracker moves from its before-winter state to tracking: October's tile fills in for each region.

title: November's ERA5-Land monthly data
site_change: November's tile fills in on the tracker for each region.

title: December's ERA5-Land monthly data
site_change: December's tile fills in on the tracker for each region.

title: January's ERA5-Land monthly data
site_change: January's tile fills in on the tracker for each region.

title: The December to February El Niño index (RONI), first release
site_change: The winter is classed as El Niño, strong El Niño or neither, and the first forecast stage is published from the registered model.

title: February's ERA5-Land monthly data
site_change: February's tile fills in, so the December to February winter the tests use is complete.

title: March's ERA5-Land monthly data
site_change: March's tile fills in, so the October to March precipitation total is complete.

title: Snowpack on 1 April (ERA5-Land)
site_change: The final forecast stage is published, with the two snowpack and winter moisture forecasts beside it, and the tracker becomes the record of what arrived when.

title: The 2027 fire season ends in PNW, BC, AB, AK and YT
site_change: The verification panel sets what burned against the forecast for PNW and AK, from WFIGS and marked provisional. BC, AB and YT follow when NBAC holds 2027.

title: The 2027 fire season ends in NorCal and SoCal
site_change: The verification panel is completed for California.

title: NBAC burned-area polygons for 2027 (no fixed date)
site_change: The verification panel gains BC, AB and YT, measured from NBAC and marked provisional.

title: CNFDB 2027 fire polygons (no fixed date)
site_change: The registered source's 2027 figures for BC, AB and YT are set beside the provisional NBAC ones, and the difference is reported.
